liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): A very well-done opener, though 74 Scarlets are strange knowing the eventual post-hiatus changes [18]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): The China to Rider transition is a creative take led by Jerry, unlike other shows [16]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Jerry's voice kicks out during the performance of Bertha [18]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Billy leads a strong attack, with Phil adding frills on the climax of the song [16]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Jerry improvises vocal melodies like no other in this prime example of the song [21]

## The recordings

- **gd74-07-31.sbd.ziggy.1019.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 233 min; rated 4.64/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's guitar sounds dreamy, while drumming is powerful with a distinct lack of cymbals; The recording features a distinct lack of cymbals in the drumming style; Pitch wavering issues are present on the recording through most of the first set [10][13][21]
- **gd1974-07-31.sbd.miller.32353.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 233 min; rated 4.39/5 by 41 [3]
- **gd1974-07-31.sbd.matera.112951.flac16**: soundboard; 34 songs; 231 min [2]
- **gd1974-07-31.121836.matrix.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 239 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Idiots babble during quiet parts, with frighteningly obstrusive sneezes and amateur tape editing [17]
- This show is a top spot, rare for 1974 three-set performances, jam-packed with good songs [12]
- The Truckin' jam is definitive of the summer 74 era, rivaling the 7/19/74 show [14]
- The Truckin' jam is a subtle head-nodding masterpiece, proving worth against other post-72 shows [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-07-31.sbd.ziggy.1019.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd1974-07-31.sbd.miller.32353.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7inch @ 7.5ips 1/2 Track) -> Dat -> CD D [3]. Also: Lineage includes Mics to Master Cassette to Reel to Dat, patched with Bill Degen's AUD; Reel flip in Row Jimmy and WRS Intro patched with Bill Degen's AUD [3]
- **gd1974-07-31.sbd.matera.112951.flac16**: transferred by Phil Matera**; source: The baseline used for this release: gd1974-07-31.1019 (SBDMR> DATx> CD> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN) I used Cool Edit 2000 to perform amplitude and EQ adjustments. EQ… [2]
- **gd1974-07-31.121836.matrix.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: 1 SBD + 1 AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix(40%-SBD/60%-AUD) [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dillon Stadium - July 31, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/july-31-1974) [23]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Vol 2 - Dillon Stadium, Hartford CT - 7/31/74 - MINT | #4657860572](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-dillon-4657860572) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dillon Stadium - July 31, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/july-31-1974) [25]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Dillon Stadium - July 31, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/july-31-1974) [26]
- Fan art by RareVinyl.com: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Volume 2: Dillon Stadium, Hartford, CT 7/31/74 US 3-CD set](https://us.rarevinyl.com/products/grateful-dead-dave-s-picks-volume-2-dillon-stadium-hartford-ct-7-31-74-us-3-cd-album-triple-set-r2529204-848360) [27]
- Poster by Steve Caraway Grateful Dead: [1974-07-31 Dillon Stadium, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1974-07-31-dillon-stadium-hartford-ct-usa/) [28]
